traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Asteliaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; veins parallel; blades linear, lanceolate, oblong or ovate; leaf rosettes basal, terminal or none; plants hermaphrodite or polygamous; ovary superior; stems woody or herbaceous; flowers in racemes or in spikes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit usually berry, rarely capsule; parts of each whorl 3 to 7; stamens 6; carpels 3 (-4). Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
